description: Coerce a computer with unconstrained delegation to authenticate, capturing its TGT for reuse.

telemetry.detail: Coercion RPC (MS-EFSR/MS-RPRN) to the victim, then the victim authenticates to the attacker-controlled unconstrained-delegation host.
TGT issued to the coerced computer account.
Unconstrained-delegation TGT capture (Rubeus monitor + coercion) is a recognised chain, modelled by MDI.

prerequisite_privilege: Control of an unconstrained-delegation host + ability to coerce the target
abuse_primitive: Rubeus monitor on the delegation host, coerce the target (SpoolSample/PetitPotam), extract the captured TGT.
notes: Coercion traffic plus a computer-account TGT to an unusual host is a strong signal, especially with MDI.
